author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: V. Here; in the matter of duties which are about to be taught under the name of Yoga, which form the source of wisdom and the worship of the Lord free from expectation of any fruit. Endeavours; even attempts to do the righteous duties are not lost or wasted, for even to make a beginning in that direction does not become futile. Even when the duty commenced is interrupted or when the performance of other duties is neglected in preference to this, there is no evil consequence befalling the individual. Even a little of this duty: any small act of duty to God is sure to lift one from the great fear of Samsara or mundane boudage. So Arjuna is exhorted to put faith in the teaching now offered to him.
